parts.name: Lid
parts.Basic_description: The lid is a detachable top cover of the kettle, made of stainless steel, typically conical in shape.
parts.Functional_description: It covers the kettle opening to retain heat and prevent water from spilling or evaporating too quickly.
parts.Movement_description: It can be lifted or rotated slightly to open or close the kettle.

parts.name: Handle
parts.Basic_description: The handle is an arched component attached to the kettle body, made of heat-resistant plastic for safe handling.
parts.Functional_description: It allows the user to hold and pour the kettle safely without direct contact with the hot metal body.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed to the kettle body and does not move independently.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body is the main container of the kettle, made of stainless steel with a spout for pouring.
parts.Functional_description: It holds and heats the water, transferring heat efficiently from the heat source to the liquid inside.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed part that does not move but can be lifted as a whole when the kettle is used.
